khm.text: Ranar was a warrior who refused to abandon his post and protected the kingdom's children when the jarl's warband was trapped, and he dies in battle against demon raiders after seeing the last of them to safety.

He wakes as a spirit on an endless tundra, realizes the Valkyries have judged him to Istfell instead of Starnheim, and resolves to prove his worth there, killing the demon guards of a river of marching spirits and reaching the gates of Istfell, where he waits for centuries as guardian.
A youth calling himself Bjorn of Beskir asks for Ranar's help, and as they kill the Elk King and the Crow King, life begins to return to Ranar, until he realizes Bjorn killed his own kin on purpose.

Atop the Bear King's tower Bjorn lets a blow land on Ranar and is revealed as Egon, god of the dead, but Firja commands Ranar to strike Egon down and names him guardian of the pass, in a cycle that will repeat as Ranar forgets.
